summary.zh: 梳理端到端流程并定位等待环节
summary.en: Map end-to-end processes, measure cycle time and find bottlenecks.

description.zh: 把采购、入职、跨部门交接等流程画成端到端链路，测算各阶段耗时，找出工作真正卡在哪里。适合流程说不清、审批总是慢半拍或准备做流程优化时使用。
description.en: Maps end-to-end business processes such as procurement, onboarding and handoffs, measures cycle time per stage and finds where work waits. Useful when a process is unclear or approvals keep stalling.
